nudge_table.reason: vocal_belief -14: lead vocal is masked — withhold the level/width pushes and clear the field around the voice first; space in the environment comes before emphasis

promotion_table.reason: loop_promotion +4.0: a foregrounded/dominating loop — treat it as generative material (source material respected) and let it evolve instead of standing still

conservative.bias: preserve the environment, subtle balance moves, nothing pushed forward

ambient_field.bias: the record as an environment — depth, air, space around every element; the voice sits inside the field

texture_bed.bias: texture as composition — weave the beds into one surface; remove what the weave does not need

horizontal_time.bias: slow evolution over sectional drama — let change arrive gradually, on the record's own time scale

generative_drift.bias: treat the material as a system — loops and beds evolve, transform, thin out; absence is a legitimate move

experimental.bias: exploration rather than aggression — unfamiliar treatments, reversed space, extreme depth, structural absence

philosophy: A mix is finished when it becomes a place: an environment the listener can stay inside, where texture carries the composition, the space between sounds is composed, and change arrives slowly enough to live with. The record works as an atmosphere first — as ignorable as it is interesting — and every element belongs to the landscape rather than standing in front of it.
aesthetic_kill_switches: Never chase reference loudness at the mix stage.
Never widen the full mix to solve chorus lift.
Never make the lead vocal less intelligible unless explicitly approved.
Never allow a stock loop to dominate the song identity by accident.
Never fill the space an element needs to decay into — the environment is part of the instrument.
Never trade the slow evolution of the record for a section-by-section jolt.
Never push a texture into the foreground to prove it is there — a field reads as a whole.
